notes.title: First Alpha is releasing
notes.content:
Junk Architect is seeing the first Alpha version.

The first Alpha has one level. Two more levels are coming soon.

Main features in the Alpha:
- Working build engine
- Menus, options settings. Missing mouse sensitivity at least
- Level and options local saving. No Steam Cloud yet
- Possible to finish the level by completing the goals
- Level finish screen with a panelled+painted version of the built house
